notes.title: Update v2.00
notes.content: [h1]◆Updates[/h1][h2]　card[/h2][p]　　・New cards and packs have been added.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/1e7ce48d8d5a1854afaf300c9af7c43f01ecf7f7.png"][/img][/p][p]　　・Improved readability of card text.[/p][h2]　competition[/h2][p]　　・The most recent information is now displayed when the user opens the "Open" menu.[/p][p]　　・Changed so that the name displayed in the log is displayed by the user name that has been set.[/p][p]　　・Added the ability to check the match log on the results screen.[/p][p]　　・Timeouts have been implemented for some timings.[/p][h2]　solo mode[/h2][p]　　・Adjustments were made to the “Blue Control” deck.[/p][p]　　・Added solo mode enemies.[/p][p]　　・The tutorial can now be tried again from the solo mode screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/708aa9e3a852657c1296c509c454176deaf9b1c8.png"][/img][/p][h2]　store[/h2][p]　　・Mission accomplishment has been made easier to understand.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/3479c17ce22db9afabe55bb0d6b3aa09f8ee2c52.png"][/img][/p][h2]　Other[/h2][p]　　・Fixed other minor bugs.[/p][h1]◆adjustment[/h1][h2]　deck building[/h2][p]　　・The deck construction rule “You must include at least one card with a power of 1-9” has been eliminated.[/p][p]　　・The number of character cards with the same name that can be included in a deck is now limited to three.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/bff1fb3a0b98bb29347d7dc28484a838def91612.png"][/img][/p][h2]　card　　[/h2][p]　　・The effects of the following cards have been adjusted[/p][p]	大炎上　[/p][p]	九死に一勝[/p][p]	捨て札加点[/p]
